import glob
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import openpyxl

paths = [p for p in glob.glob('**/*.xlsx', recursive=True) if not p.split('/')[-1].startswith('~$')]
print('FILES', paths[:6])
p = next((x for x in paths if 'delivery' in x.lower()), paths[0])
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(p, data_only=True)
print('SHEETS', wb.sheetnames)

ws = wb['Material']
print('MATERIAL rows', ws.max_row)
print('MATERIAL head', [r for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=4, values_only=True)])
print('MATERIAL types', [tuple(type(c).__name__ for c in r) for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=3, values_only=True)])

ws = wb['Pack sizes']
print('PACK', [(r[0], r[1], type(r[1]).__name__) for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True)])

ws = wb['Price history']
pr = [r for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True) if any(c is not None for c in r)]
print('PRICE rows', len(pr))
print('COMBOS', Counter((str(r[1]).strip().upper(), str(r[2]).strip().upper(), str(r[3])[:10], str(r[4])[:10]) for r in pr))
sel = [r for r in pr if str(r[1]).strip().upper() == 'RETAIL' and str(r[2]).strip().upper() == 'THB']
print('RETAIL THB count', len(sel), Counter(str(r[0]) for r in sel))
sel2 = [r for r in sel if str(r[3])[:10] <= '2026-11-03' <= str(r[4])[:10]]
print('RETAIL THB covering 2026-11-03', len(sel2), sorted((str(r[0]), r[5]) for r in sel2))
print('price cell types', Counter(type(r[5]).__name__ for r in pr))

ws = wb['Batches']
br = [r for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True) if any(c is not None for c in r)]
print('BATCH rows', len(br), 'qty types', Counter(type(r[3]).__name__ for r in br))
d = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list))
for r in br:
    d[str(r[0])][str(r[4]).strip().upper()].append((str(r[1]), str(r[2]), r[3]))
for k in sorted(d):
    print(k, {u: len(v) for u, v in d[k].items()}, {u: sorted(set(x[0] for x in v)) for u, v in d[k].items()})
print('BATCH sample', br[:3])
